quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: The Search
quest.description: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency seems to have something he needs help with...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Traveler, please wait. Sango would like your help.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: She didn't tell me. She just said that she still needed to make some preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: She also told me to wait for you and ask if you would perform a search in the wilds together with me.

choices.text: What does she intend to accomplish?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Well... to be honest, I have no clue either. But if we do what Sango tells us to, we can usually solve the case.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Well. On that note, let's talk business.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: According to Sango, the patrol in the city has indeed been reinforced ever since Amano and Andou reported that incident.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: But strangely enough, the merchants in the city are still becoming victims of theft. And the perpetrators' intention is very clear. They aren't interested in anything else other than some targeted items.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Here is the situation. Sango believes that the probability of the Treasure Hoarders sneaking into town to perform these crimes is very low.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: The suspect... or suspects, have a clear objective.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It's very likely that there has been a mole inside the city this whole time, passing off information to people outside the city.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Doesn't that mean the Doushins' actions are futile?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Not at all. It's exactly what we want. Because our culprit seems to have realized that he is not the target of the Doushin yet, he will continue committing crimes.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: The more crimes he commits, the easier it is for him to give himself away, and greater the chance for Sango to figure out who he really is.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Therefore, we still need to keep putting on a show so that our thief will let his guard down.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Traveler, that's why I am here asking you to come with me and look for some trouble with those Treasure Hoarders in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Of course, there will be payment. Also... when this case is over, there will be an additional gift for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did Sango ask you to say this stuff too?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Hmm... you sensed that? You have quite a sharp intuition...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It was indeed Sango who told me to persuade you with these words.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: But please believe me when I say that I am not lying. I am certainly carrying your payment with me, at least.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Therefore, please help us out, Traveler.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What exactly do you need me to do?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It's easy. We just need... to mess with those Treasure Hoarders in the wilderness. The bigger the fracas, the better.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sango has already marked the locations of some Treasure Hoarder camps. I have also marked them on the map for you.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Alright, we will rendezvous at this place afterward. Let's get a move on now.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It's her habit, really. She said that she... "is good at thinking, but less so at doing."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: A while ago, a novelist came to interview her, wanting to turn her story into a novel.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: He even referred to Sango as an "armchair detective." She seems to have taken a liking to this nickname, and has been thinking of buying an armchair since.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: But because of funding issues, we can't really get an armchair yet.

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: These people are quite quick to flee.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: They probably went back to report about us. In this case, our objective has been accomplished.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Thank you for your hard work, Traveler. Please take these.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I will also return and report to Sango about this.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I wonder if she's figured something out yet...

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp
Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: There are indeed a lot of Treasure Hoarders here.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Let's go, Traveler. Time to have a little chat with them.
